english.title: Keeper fail to return equine ID to issuing body upon slaughter / death of equine within 30 days
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a keeper of an equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..) who, in accordance with Article 35(1) of Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/262, was required to return an ID to the issuing body, failed to do so within a period of 30 days of the death or loss of the equine
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(2), 22(2) and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
